items.title: IT sector Q1FY27 review: Tier-2 firms lead revenue growth amid soft demand
items.description: IT Q1FY27 review: As per MOFSL, revenue growth in Q1 was led by Tier-2 pack IT services companies. Tier-1 players grew 0.4 per cent Q-o-Q CC, while Tier-2 players outperformed with 1.8 per cent growth

items.title: Nifty makes history; fails to cross previous day's high for 12 straight sessions
items.description: While Nifty may be struggling to make new highs, history, analysts said, suggests such extended periods of failing to cross the previous day's high have often been followed by a meaningful upside.
